items.title: An integral stack has a sober irreducible space with a unique generic point and a dense open gerbe over an integral scheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an integral algebraic stack has a sober irreducible space with a unique generic point, and contains a dense open substack which is a gerbe over an integral scheme (author lemma at source lines 10650-10658, label lemma-structure-integral-stack). The proof (source lines 10660-10684) applies the sobriety proposition, takes the dense open gerbe supplied by the open stratum result, argues that its base is decent with irreducible space, that reducedness of the gerbe forces the base to be reduced and hence integral, and finally shrinks the base to an integral scheme (proof lines 10660-10683). The reducedness argument on the base is the substance. H3.
